en.lead: One Rust stack for GPU kernels, compute libraries, tensors, and models. Build at the level you need. Stay connected to the layers below.
en.stackLead: Low-level control. High-level composition. Clear boundaries between every layer.
en.chooseLead: Write a kernel, train a model, or bring native operations to PyTorch.
en.kernelDesc: Explore the Rust kernel DSL, execution model, and direct PTX path.
en.torchDesc: Run on ruda:0 with native operators, streams, and first-order training.
en.modelDesc: Prepare model weights and explore text and image inference with ruLLM.
en.compute: The right library for the operation.
en.quickDesc: Clone the workspace, then follow the environment guide for your GPU and toolchain.
en.installNote: The NVIDIA path needs Rust/Cargo, a linker, an NVIDIA driver, and the CUDA Toolkit.
